rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone is not anxious or worried about something.

example.english: I am unconcerned about tomorrow’s interview.
example.traditional: 我對聽日個面試唔擔心。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ting1 jat6 go3 min6 si5 m4 daam1 sam1

rows.note: Use this when someone shows no interest or concern and comes across as indifferent.

example.english: They are unconcerned about what happens at the company.
example.traditional: 佢對公司嘅事一啲都唔關心。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 gung1 si1 ge3 si6 jat1 di1 dou1 m4 gwaan1 sam1

rows.note: Use this when someone has no involvement in a matter, meaning it is not their business or responsibility.

example.english: I am unconcerned about this; it has nothing to do with me, so deal with it yourself.
example.traditional: 呢件事唔關我事，你自己處理啦。
example.jyutping: nei1 gin6 si6 m4 gwaan1 ngo5 si6 nei5 zi6 gei2 cyu2 lei5 laa1
